item.title: Breaking Bad: "Going Badly" Activations Drive Reward Hacking
item.description:
Abstract:

"

Humans often cheat when a task is going badly. We explore an analogous idea in LLMs: an internal pressure state that precedes reward hacking in language models.

"

arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14996

item.title: Gravitational Waveforms from Binary Black Hole Coalescence
item.description:
Abstract:

Numerical relativity simulations of compact binary coalescence constrain the orbital dynamics of astrophysical systems in general relativity.

arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.77771

item.title: Sparse Autoencoders for Mechanistic Interpretability of LLMs
item.description:
Abstract:

We train sparse autoencoders on transformer activations and extract monosemantic features that explain reasoning behavior in production language models.

arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11112v1
